methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); subscription software signals with salesforce.com's rule-T thresholds; the listing rule (CRM listed 2004-06-23)

pit_profile.why: 'Salesforce, Inc. (“Salesforce,” the “Company,” “we” or “our”) is a global leader in customer relationship management (“CRM”) technology, helping organizations of any size become agentic enterprises.' 'The market for our service offerings is highly competitive, rapidly evolving and fragmented, and subject to changing technology with low barriers to entry, shifting customer needs and frequent introductions of new products and services.' 'The markets in which we participate are intensely competitive, and if we do not compete effectively, our operating results could be harmed.' (FY2026 10-K); DURABLE: no 10-K read calls the business cyclical ('cyclical' appears only of the economy's downturns, and of 'the cyclical nature and seasonality of our sales cycle and our customers’ businesses'); of the live themes in taxonomy_eras.json (OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance', GLP1 to 'GLP-1 obesity drugs reduce demand for snacks, beverages, sleep-apnea/diabetes/cardio devices': the FY2026 10-K names cloud computing as salesforce.com's own model, the side that displaces on-premise software, not a substitute for it, and names no offshore delivery; ECOMMERCE, STREAMING, ENERGY_TRANSITION, EV, CRYPTO and GLP1 name no software business), only GENAI is on the watch list: it is scoped to 'generative / autonomous AI substitutes the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content, mobility', and FY2026 10-K names AI vendors among salesforce.com's competitors, company-acknowledged with no market read (the MSFT and GOOG rule)

theme_watch.reason: Live: Salesforce's own FY2026 10-K, under 'The markets in which we participate are intensely competitive, and if we do not compete effectively, our operating results could be harmed.', names among its current competitors 'AI-native companies and emerging startups that leverage generative AI and large language models as the core foundation of their architecture, offering highly specialized, autonomous, or automated solutions that may bypass traditional business process workflows or displace established user interfaces' and 'vendors who offer software tailored to specific services, industries or market segments, as opposed to our full suite of service offerings, including suppliers of traditional business intelligence and data preparation products, integration software vendors, marketing vendors, e-commerce solutions vendors or AI software and service vendors'. It builds AI of its own: 'Founded in 1999, we bring humans, agents, applications, and data together on a trusted, unified platform to unlock growth and innovation.' The stock trades at 21.5x FY27E — a discount to its own history. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (GENAI) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing generative-AI substitution of salesforce.com's software seats specifically.

BASE.desc: EPS +9.7%/yr (Q2 FY27 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.5-yr ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 ex-FY23 median

BULL.desc: EPS +41.3%/yr (FY18-FY26 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 ex-FY23 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

summary: CRM (retrospective, 2026-07-17) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.04x (-17.9% downside to Bear $201.39 / +470.8% upside to Bull $974.67) | Adj composite 1.95 vs market 1.22: gap +0.73 [UNDERVALUED] | -40% above the EPP floor $286.56 (36x FY27E $7.96) | Conservative 2-yr case: +145.5% total (+72.8%/yr) | At 21.5x FY27E the 15% hurdle price $225.84 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +13.3% YoY in Q1 FY27, forward revenues +10.1-10.9% (Q2 FY27 revenue guide (Q1 FY27 release)); generative AI is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
